the eggplant fiber has the potential to be used in the production of functional food.
1) the use of eggplant fiber in the formulation of cupcake is possible and acceptable to consumers.

the formulation of a functional cupcake with eggplant fiber.
the optimization of cupcake formulation using eggplant fiber as a functional ingredient in order to improve the quality and nutritional value of this product.
the formulation of a functional food with high nutritional and antioxidant properties.

the addition of eggplant fiber to the formulation of cupcakes can increase the nutritional value of the product.
the eggplant fiber has been successfully used to replace the wheat flour and improve the nutritional value of the cupcakes without affecting the quality of the final product.

, the results obtained by the optimization of the formulation of the cupcake with different levels of fiber replacement, using response surface methodology and the central composite design, showed that the best formulation for the production of the cupcake was the one with 10% of eggplant fiber replacement and the amount of 1.8% eggplant fiber in the final product, which is the highest level of fiber in the cupcake.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the addition of dietary fiber from eggplants can be used to improve the texture of the cupcake and increase the amount of fiber in the cupcake.
nasunin can be used as a natural antioxidant.

the use of eggplant fiber in the formulation of cakes and cupcakes is possible, but it should be considered that with an increase in eggplant fiber in formulations, the volume of products decreases, and the texture and color of the product change.
